title: Mixed Event — A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?! — Episode8 A Very Special White Day

meta.Event: A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?!
meta.Episode: Episode8 — A Very Special White Day
meta.Event Outline: Not long before White Day, Tsukasa is set to perform as an extra at a facility where visitors can make their own chocolates. Meanwhile, Mizuki has come up with plans for White Day return gifts, and invites Akito along for some chocolate making.

rows.Line: Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phew... I can finally relax...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We had to deal with quite a lot today, but our show turned out well and the Chocolate Factory was all smiles in the end. However, most importantly...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Nice work today, Tsukasa!
Everyone was smiling from ear to ear in the end!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Len!
I'm sorry that we couldn't talk much today.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That's totally fine! Your show was just that amazing♪ Also...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I got a great idea and I think I know what we should do for White Day now♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really?! That's great!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! So...>
White Day
Kamiyama High School - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey♪
Morning, you two!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Morning, Akiyama.
You're here early.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well duh! I want everyone to actually eat the chocolates I made♪ Starting with you...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, are these the ones you and Akito made?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! And you gotta hear this, Toya! Do you know what we had to go through to actually make these...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Akito told me all about what happened. It was quite the tale.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, you already heard?
Darn. I was hoping to see the look on your face when I told you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I'm sorry you missed your opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what are you apologizing for...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, when are you seeing Ena and the others?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: After school! You?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I gave Toya his chocolates.
And I'll give the others their gifts before practice later today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, okay! Did you already eat yours, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, not yet.
I was hoping that we could have some together later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. You're so patient!
I hope An and Kohane like what they get! Same with you, Li'l Bro!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And there's Rui right in the nick of time...! Later, guys! Hey, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Gone, just like that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I mean, how can anyone always be that peppy...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
Thanks for everything! Here!
Hang on... Are you building something weird again?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I guess it is a special day, so I'll give Akiyama a pass...
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And for the finale...!
The shiny gift that appeared before the prince is...! Three! Two! One!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Woooaaahhh!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A big, white Pegasus! In chocolate form! It's adorable!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This looks amazing! It's a horsey, but it's really chocolate! Also, it's almost as big as a birthday cake!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to receive anything like this after that show...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm just as surprised!
These are incredible, Tsukasa.
Where did you buy them?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Buy?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just tell us already.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hehehe... I hope you're ready!
I made all of these!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?! You made these?!
I don't believe it!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I performed in a show at the Chocolate Factory, and it went over so well that they showed me how to make large-scale chocolates!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That's wonderful, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hold on...
Isn't that the same place you went, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, she just happened to be there to see my show, and even gave me a surprise gift at the end!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?!
Why didn't you tell us sooner, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because... It would've been a pain... I mean, Tsukasa's a better storyteller than me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're so lucky!
I wish I was there to see it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's our Tsukasa for you.
He'll find a way to become a hit even at the Chocolate Factory.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! As a future star should!
However, to be fair, it wasn't all smooth sailing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But you found a way, right♪
You became a star even in the world of chocolate, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
A star in the world of chocolate?
Wouldn't that mean he's a chocolatier...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, can I start with one of the wings?! Pretty please!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! Start from wherever you like! There's plenty to go around for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay! Woohoo!
A chocolate horsey party with everybody here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we get started?
Ready?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Let's dig in!
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And Tsukasa had to ad-lib that whole time, but the show ended up being a huge success!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Whoa! That's amazing!
It must've been an incredible show♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm glad everyone got to smile in the end☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I had a feeling you got to see something really fun when you got back, but I wasn't expecting anything like this!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
I have a little surprise in store!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A surprise?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Presents for all of you guys!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow! Are these chocolates of us?!
They're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, this one looks like me☆
Luka, wake up! You gotta see these!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Oh, these chocolates are adorable... And this one even looks just like me. That's so lovely♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
They're all lovely!
Are these homemade?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! They're my way of thanking you guys for Valentine's Day! I had Tsukasa make them for me while he was making his chocolates!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You got everyone return gifts?
Why didn't you tell me, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sorry!
I promise to make up for it during our show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? What show?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. We actually have a surprise show in store for all of you today!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
What?!
Where did you find the time to prepare for that?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Mhm...
I can't wait to see your show, KAITO, Len♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks!
It's guaranteed to blow you all away, so make sure to stay awake through the end!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So let's get our special White Day show started!
